Search a Word document for the best-matching passage to a paraphrase

Source: R/docx.R
crd_docx_srch_clm.Rd

Converts a paraphrase to search tokens (stripping citation keys and markdown), then scores each paragraph in the document by the proportion of tokens found. Returns the top n_results matching paragraphs with their document index and style.

Usage

crd_docx_srch_clm(docx_txt, paraphrase, n_results = 3L, min_score = 0.2)

Arguments

docx_txt

data.frame as returned by crd_docx_ext_txt().

paraphrase

character(1) paraphrase text from the audit CSV.

n_results

integer(1) number of top matches to return. Default 3L.

min_score

numeric(1) minimum token-match proportion to include. Default 0.2.

Value

A tibble with columns doc_index, style_name, text, score, ordered by descending score. Returns zero rows if no match exceeds min_score.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
doc <- crd_docx_ext_txt("background/price_etal2026.docx")
crd_docx_srch_clm(doc, "beaver dams moderate summer stream temperatures")
} # }
